Native files, guides, notices and release manifest match; auxiliary inspector receipt records the different local merge HEAD and ordering, changing its ZIP and appended release-notes hash. Only the original CI files are selected for distribution; no bit-for-bit reproducibility claim.
One local YAML validation attempt used a venv without PyYAML; host Python parsed the workflow and ran the actual-file validator successfully.
Experimental shader/legacy product jobs intentionally did not run; no shader, Bedrock or unrelated OS improvement is claimed.
Windows installer unsigned; Mac development/ad hoc signatures, not notarized. No signing credentials or new paid services used.
Historical bounded dependency review is retained; complete current native/transitive vulnerabilities, Qt licensing/corresponding source and distribution risk disposition remain gates.
